name: archive.today capture lists (archive.ph)
tier_rationale: Anonymous operator without published terms or privacy policy (A8 unknown); P304 cond 4 names archive.today an unknown-tier host: 'unknown operator' badge, IOC values only, excluded at AMBER and above.

reliability.justification: Unknown operator (A8): manual pivot links only, never an automated verdict.

capture_lists.title: archive.ph capture lists /{url} and /newest/{url} (manual pivot links, never /submit)

terms.quote: Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)

capture_lists.notes: Research C0192: CAPTCHA-protected for automation and connection resets from the datacenter egress (rule 1: no CAPTCHA bypass). A new capture makes archive.today fetch the target, so submit pages are never linked (P304 cond 7). Used by pivots_unverified.

notes: Manual pivot links only (P304 cond 1): V3LUM never requests these pages, not even from doctor, and never solves their challenges; the analyst opens them in a browser. No budget. Owned by batch p2-G14-3 (module pivots_unverified); other batches extend it with <id>__<batch>.json.
